home.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know before you start. Still have a question? We are happy to help.

agency.a: No. We are a platform, not an agency. Businesses find talents and contact them (or their manager) directly, and talents set their own services and prices.

data.q: Where does the profile data come from?
data.a: Profiles are built from public sources such as official social media accounts, websites and press coverage, and the sources are listed on every profile. When a talent claims their profile, they can correct and update it themselves, and anyone can report a mistake.

free.q: Is it free? Is there a free trial?
free.a: Yes, it is free right now: searching profiles, creating an account, claiming your profile, shortlists, hire requests and agreements. There is no trial to start and no card needed. If we add paid plans later, we will announce them first.

verification.q: What does the verified badge mean?
verification.a: It means the person behind the profile has proved it is theirs. Our team sends a one-time code to one of their official accounts, the talent enters it, and an admin approves the claim. Businesses and managers are verified by our team too.

claim.q: How do I claim my profile?
claim.a: Search for your name and open your profile, then click "Is this you? Claim". If you cannot find yourself, create your profile from your dashboard. It goes live once your claim is approved.

hiring.q: Who can hire talents, and how?
hiring.a: Verified businesses can send a hire request to verified talents, with the project, budget and dates. The talent (or their manager) accepts or declines, and an accepted request becomes an agreement both sides sign.

manager.q: Can my manager handle things for me?
manager.a: Yes. Invite your verified manager from "My manager" and choose what they may do: manage your profile and services, and handle hire requests and agreements, including signing for you. Signatures show it was signed on your behalf, and you can change permissions or remove your manager at any time.

payments.q: How do agreements and payments work?
payments.a: Agreements set out the scope, milestones, amounts, payment terms and usage rights, and both sides sign with a code sent to their email. Payments are made directly between the business and the talent as agreed; the platform does not hold or process money yet.

about.title: We help the world find, hire and work with the people who move it
about.subtitle: One trusted platform for creators, journalists, speakers, experts and public figures, and for the businesses and managers who work with them: verified profiles, real numbers, open campaigns, signed agreements and honest reviews.
about.mission1: Finding the right voice for a campaign, event or story is slow and full of guesswork. Numbers are scattered across apps, it is hard to know who to contact, and deals are made over chats with nothing in writing.
about.mission2: We put the whole journey in one place: discover people with transparent reach, hire them directly or through an open campaign, agree on terms in a signed digital agreement, track the work milestone by milestone, and review each other when it is done.
about.howSubtitle: From the first search to the final review, in four steps.
about.step1Body: Search talent by profession, industry, topic, country, language and reach, or browse open campaigns, businesses and managers.
about.step2Body: A verified business sends a hire request for a service, or talents apply to its campaign. Contacts open up on both sides once the talent says yes.
about.step3Body: Both sides shape the terms, milestones and amounts in one agreement, then sign it with a one-time code sent to their email.
about.step4Body: The talent delivers each milestone, the business approves or asks for changes, and when it is complete both leave a star review.
about.featuresSubtitle: What talent, managers and businesses can already do here.

features.searchBody: Filter by profession, industry, topic, country, city, language, followers and who is open for work. Every card shows reach and star rating.
features.claimBody: Talents claim their profile with a code sent to their official social account. Verified profiles get a badge and are edited only by their owner.
features.servicesBody: Talents list what they offer (keynotes, brand campaigns, sponsored posts…) with fixed, range or on-request pricing, and say what they are open to.
features.hireBody: Verified businesses send a request with a brief and budget. The talent or their manager accepts or declines, and contacts are shared only after a yes.
features.campaignsBody: Businesses post a campaign with a brief, budget, country and deadline. Talents apply with a pitch, and selected talents go straight into the hiring flow.
features.agreementsBody: Terms, milestones and payments in writing, signed by both sides with an email code, with delivery, approval, change requests and dispute handling built in.
features.reviewsBody: Reviews come only from completed agreements, so they are real. Cards show the average and how many businesses rated the talent.
features.managersBody: Verified managers link to their talents only with the talent's approval and only the permissions they give: edit the profile, handle hire requests, or both.
features.businessesBody: Public pages list every business, organization and manager on the platform, with their type and verification status.
features.shortlistsBody: Businesses save talents into lists per campaign, add private notes and compare up to four people side by side.
features.notificationsBody: Every request, application, signature and review lands in your notifications, sorted into tabs like Hiring, Campaigns and Agreements.
features.safetyBody: Admins review claims, businesses and managers, handle reports and keep an audit log. Logins, codes and links are protected with rate limits and secure cookies.

about.forTitle: Built for three kinds of accounts

for.talent1: Claim or create your profile and show a verified badge.
for.talent2: List your services, prices and availability.
for.talent3: Get hire requests and apply to open campaigns.
for.talent4: Sign agreements and build your star rating.
for.manager1: Get verified as a manager or agency.
for.manager2: Link with your talents, with their approval.
for.manager4: Answer all their hire requests from one inbox.
for.business1: Companies, brands, agencies, NGOs, universities, event organizers and government bodies.
for.business2: Get verified, then hire talent directly or post a campaign.
for.business3: Shortlist and compare people with real numbers.
for.business4: Work under signed agreements and leave reviews.

about.valuesSubtitle: The rules every profile and deal on the platform follows.
about.value1Body: Followers and engagement are shown per platform, with the source of the information. No mystery score.
about.value2Body: Talents, managers and businesses are verified by our team before they can hire, represent or edit a profile.
about.value3Body: Reviews come only from completed work. Profiles start from public sources, and anyone can report a mistake or ask for removal.
about.value4Body: The whole site works in English, Urdu and Arabic, including right-to-left layouts, starting with Pakistan and the Gulf.
about.faq1Q: Where does the profile information come from?
about.faq1A: From public sources such as official websites and social accounts. After a person claims their profile, they keep it up to date themselves.
about.faq2Q: How do I claim my profile?
about.faq2A: Create a talent account, open your profile and press "Is this you? Claim it". We send a code to one of your official social accounts; enter it on your dashboard. If you can't find your profile, create one yourself with at least one social account.
about.faq3Q: What does the verified badge mean?
about.faq3A: The profile was claimed by the real person and confirmed with a code or by our team. Businesses and managers are verified separately before they can hire or represent anyone.
about.faq4A: A verified business posts a campaign. Talents with a profile apply with a short pitch. The business selects or rejects applicants; a selected talent gets an accepted hire request and the agreement starts from there.
about.faq5Q: How are agreements signed and paid?
about.faq5A: Both sides agree on the terms and milestones, then each signs with a code sent to their email. Payment is arranged between the two sides for now; the platform keeps the signed record, deliveries and approvals.
about.faq6A: Only the two sides of a completed agreement. That is why every star on a talent's profile comes from real work.
about.faq7Q: Something on a profile is wrong. What can I do?
about.faq7A: Open the profile and use "Report an error or request removal". Our team reviews every report.
about.ctaBody: Browse talent and open campaigns for free. Create an account to claim your profile, hire, or post a campaign.
about.band: Real reach. Real people. Real agreements.
about.bandBody: No guesswork and no screenshots of chats. Everything is checked, written down and signed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information {{platform}} collects, how we use it and the choices you have. By using {{platform}}, you agree to this policy.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: {{platform}} is a platform where businesses find journalists, creators, speakers and experts, and where those people manage their public profiles and work. You can reach us at {{email}}.

sections.title: Public profiles
sections.body: Many profiles are created from public sources such as official social media accounts, websites and press coverage, and the sources are listed on each profile. A profile shows public information only, such as name, profession, location, social accounts, follower counts and engagement. If a profile is about you, you can claim it to correct it, or ask us to hide or remove it.

sections.title: Information you give us
sections.body: When you create an account we collect your name, email address, password (stored only as a secure hash) and account type. Depending on how you use the platform, we also keep the details you add: your profile, services and availability, company or manager details, proof links for verification, hire requests, shortlists, agreements, reviews and reports, and your newsletter subscription.

sections.title: Information collected automatically
sections.body: We use cookies that keep you logged in and remember settings such as your language and theme. Our servers record basic technical data (such as IP address and request times) to keep the service secure, for example to limit repeated login attempts.

sections.title: How we use information
sections.body: We use information to run the platform: to show profiles and search results, verify talents, businesses and managers, deliver hire requests, agreements and notifications, send emails you need (such as sign-in and signing codes), prevent abuse, and improve the service. We send the newsletter only to people who subscribe.

sections.title: Who can see what
sections.body: Public profiles are visible to everyone. Contact details in a hire request are shared between a business and a talent only after the talent accepts. Agreements are visible to the people in them (and to a talent's manager when the talent allows it), and to our admins when needed to resolve a dispute. We do not sell personal information.

sections.title: Service providers
sections.body: We use trusted providers to host our servers and database and to send email. They process data only to provide those services to us.

sections.title: How long we keep information
sections.body: We keep your information while your account is active. When you delete your account, we delete your account data, and you can choose to also remove your public profile. Some records, such as signed agreements, may be kept where needed to resolve disputes or meet legal duties.

sections.title: Your choices and rights
sections.body: You can update most of your information in your settings and dashboard, delete your account from Settings, and unsubscribe from the newsletter using the link in any email. To ask for a copy of your data, a correction or deletion, email {{email}}.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: We protect information with measures such as hashed passwords, secure cookies, rate limits and access controls. No online service can be completely secure, so please keep your password private.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy. When we make important changes, we will update the date at the top of this page and, where appropriate, let you know.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you and {{platform}} for using the website and services. By creating an account or using {{platform}}, you agree to them.

sections.title: Using the platform
sections.body: You must be old enough to form a binding contract where you live, or have permission from a parent or guardian. Use the platform only for lawful purposes and in line with these terms.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: Give accurate information and keep it up to date. You are responsible for activity on your account and for keeping your password safe. Tell us at {{email}} if you think someone else has used your account.

sections.title: Profiles and claims
sections.body: Only claim a profile that is really about you. Claims are checked with a one-time code and approved by our team before the verified badge appears. We may refuse or remove a claim, and hide or correct a profile, if information is false or misleading.

sections.title: Businesses, managers and hiring
sections.body: Businesses and managers must give true details for verification. Verified businesses can send hire requests to verified talents. A manager may act for a talent only with the talent's permission, and the talent can change or remove that permission at any time.

sections.title: Agreements and payments
sections.body: Agreements made on {{platform}} are between the business and the talent (or the manager acting for the talent). {{platform}} is not a party to them and does not guarantee the work. Payments are made directly between the parties as agreed; the platform does not hold or process money. If a dispute arises, our team may help, but the parties remain responsible for their agreement.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not post false, unlawful, hateful or infringing content; impersonate anyone; harass other users; send spam; scrape the platform or try to break its security; or use it to collect other people's data without permission.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body: You keep ownership of the content you add, such as profile text, photos and reviews. You allow {{platform}} to show and use it to run the platform. Make sure you have the right to share anything you upload.

sections.title: Reviews and reports
sections.body: Reviews must be honest and based on real work. Anyone can report a profile; we review reports and may hide content while we check it.

sections.title: Suspension and ending your account
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time from Settings. We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms or put others at risk.

sections.title: Disclaimers and liability
sections.body: The platform is provided "as is". We work to keep information accurate, but follower counts and other data come from public sources and may change or contain errors. To the extent the law allows, {{platform}} is not liable for indirect losses or for the actions of users.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms. When we make important changes, we will update the date at the top of this page. Continuing to use the platform after a change means you accept the new terms.
